items.q: How much does custom software development cost?
items.a: It depends on scope. A basic website starts at $500 USD. A platform with database, admin panel and integrations can range from $1,500 to $8,000 USD. Use our AI quoter to get an estimate in seconds.
A basic site can be ready in 1-2 weeks. A full platform takes 4 to 12 weeks depending on complexity. We always provide a detailed timeline before starting.

items.q: Do I own the source code?
items.a: Yes. 100% of the source code is yours. No platform dependencies, no hidden licenses. You can take it to any other developer if needed.
We offer post-launch support, team training and ongoing assistance for future evolutions. We don't disappear after delivery.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside Colombia?
items.a: Yes. We have clients in Colombia, the United States and other Latin American countries. We work in Spanish and English and adapt to any time zone.
